meta.title: 16Launcher — free Minecraft launcher with mod support
meta.description: Free Minecraft launcher for Windows, Linux and macOS. Forge, Fabric, NeoForge and Quilt, mods and modpacks from Modrinth and CurseForge, sign in with Microsoft, Ely.by or play offline.

features.title: Performance
features.text: Built with Rust and Tauri. The launcher starts quickly and uses little memory, leaving resources for the game.

features.title: Instance management
features.text: Each instance keeps its own game version, mods and settings. Mods from Modrinth and CurseForge install directly in the launcher, together with their dependencies.

features.title: Open source
features.text: The source code is published on GitHub. Anyone can review it or build the launcher themselves.

capabilities.subtitle: Everything the launcher does, grouped by area. It's written in Rust and runs on Windows, Linux and macOS.

items.question: Is it safe?
items.answer: Yes. The launcher's source code is open and available for review on GitHub. We recommend downloading the launcher only from the official website or the GitHub releases page.

items.question: Is it suitable for low-end PCs?
items.answer: Yes. The launcher is written in Rust and uses few resources. Hardware requirements depend on the game version and installed mods; for low-end systems there is a "Low memory" Java preset.

items.question: Which Minecraft versions are supported?
items.answer: All official Minecraft versions are supported, including alphas and snapshots, as well as the Forge, NeoForge, Fabric and Quilt loaders. A custom version can be added from a .jar file.

items.question: Can I install mods?
items.answer: Yes. Mods from Modrinth and CurseForge can be found and installed right in the launcher, and dependencies are installed automatically. If mods conflict, the launcher reports it and suggests a fix.

items.question: Do I need to install Java separately?
items.answer: No. The launcher automatically downloads the Java version required by the selected game version. You can also specify a Java installation you already have.

items.question: Can I create multiple profiles?
items.answer: Yes. Each game version or modpack gets a separate instance with its own mods, settings and folder.

items.question: How much does it cost?
items.answer: The launcher is completely free. Its source code is open on GitHub, and you can support development on Boosty.

items.question: Do I need a Microsoft account?
items.answer: No. You can sign in with Microsoft or Ely.by, or create an offline account with any name. You can keep several accounts and give each instance its own.

items.question: Can I play with friends without a public IP?
items.answer: Yes. Create a room in the launcher and invite friends with a code: no port forwarding or public IP needed. Rooms can be public or private, with a password and a player limit.

items.question: How do I move instances from another launcher?
items.answer: On first launch the launcher offers to migrate your data. It imports from PrismLauncher, MultiMC, ATLauncher, GDLauncher and CurseForge, as well as Modrinth (.mrpack) and CurseForge modpacks.

items.question: What if the game crashes?
items.answer: Open the game console: the log analyzer reads the crash report and tells you what broke. It also offers quick fixes: disable the faulty mod, add memory or switch Java back to automatic. If that does not help, ask on Discord.
